- Brooklyn Community Board 1 is a New York City community board that encompasses the Brooklyn neighborhoods of Williamsburg and Greenpoint.
- Brooklyn Community Board 1 is bounded by Newtown Creek and the Queens borough line on the east, Flushing Avenue and Kent Avenue on the south, and the East River on the west.
- Newtown Creek is a 3.5-mile-long tributary of the East River and an estuary that forms part of the border between the New York City boroughs of Brooklyn and Queens.
- Channelization made Newtown Creek one of the most heavily used bodies of water in the Port of New York and New Jersey and one of the most polluted industrial sites in the United States.
- Newtown Creek contains years of discarded toxins, an estimated 30,000,000 US gallons of spilled oil including the Greenpoint oil spill, raw sewage from New York City’s sewer system, and accumulation from 1,491 sites.
- Williamsburg is part of Brooklyn Community Board 1, and the neighborhood is served in the south by the NYPD 90th Precinct and in the north by the NYPD 94th Precinct.
